messages:
jess-ux: Quick design review — posting the latest roles panel comp and a11y checklist. Looking for thoughts on: compact vs expanded rows, where to place the SSO toggle, and how the audit filters should behave on nav.

maria-product: Thanks Jess, will scan. Priorities: clarity for admins, and avoiding accidental permission escalations. Recommend keeping full role names visible on hover in compact mode.

samir-eng: From infra POV, compact rows are fine but we need consistent keyboard focus targets. If rows collapse, tab order must still land on the primary action. Also watch render cost for very large orgs (1000+ roles).

jess-ux: Good point re: tab order. Proposed: each row has 3 focusable items: chevron (expand), role name (link), actions menu. That keeps deterministic order. Thoughts?

olivia-security: Prefer explicit affordance for inheritance. Small dot + tooltip isn't enough for auditors. Also the SSO toggle needs an audit trail event when flipped.

tulio-pm: On SSO toggle placement — current comp has it inline with role metadata. Could be confusing. Alternative: global SSO rules section in org settings, with per-role override link that opens a modal.

jess-ux: I prototyped both. Inline toggle (A) vs modal override (B). A is faster for power users; B reduces accidental toggles. Link to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/roles-panel-v7 (please open, comment on pages named "compact" and "per-role-sso").

maria-product: Also copy nits: the inline tooltip currently says "Enable SSO for this role" — change to "Allow sign-in via SSO for members of this role" for clarity. And the confirmation modal should include the audit impact (e.g., "This change will affect X members").

samir-eng: Quick implementation note: if we do per-role overrides, backend needs to resolve precedence: org SSO setting -> role override -> user-level exceptions. We should add an explicit column in the roles table called "SSO policy" showing Effective/Overridden.

jess-ux: Love that. For compact layout, propose abbreviated policy badges: "E" (effective), "O" (override) with aria-labels. Example markup suggestion I added in notes:

```
<button aria-label="SSO policy: Effective - organization-wide">E</button>
<button aria-label="SSO policy: Overridden for this role">O</button>
```

maria-product: Accessibility nit: be sure badges don't rely on color alone (we use text + shape). Also screen reader text should announce "SSO policy: effective, managed at org level".

olivia-security: Audit log navigation — when clicking a role and selecting "View audit", the filter should be prefilled: role_id + event types (sso_change, permission_change). Right now the filter UX forces users to rebuild queries.

tulio-pm: Agreed. Prepopulating filters removes friction. Also consider deep-links so support can paste a URL that opens the audit with filters applied.

samir-eng: For large orgs, prepopulating queries could lead to heavy queries. Backend should rate-limit or use pagination cursor. Add a small spinner and progressive load.

jess-ux: UX microflow for keyboard users: allow Enter on role to open quick panel, Escape to close, arrow keys to move between rows while panel open. Also included a small animation to indicate focus movement. Any accessibility objections?

maria-product: Animation OK if prefers-reduced-motion is respected.

olivia-security: One more: require an extra confirmation step (checkbox) for role changes that grant admin-level perms. Prevents accidental elevation.

design-bot: Auto-checklist: [x] contrast ratios, [ ] focus order validated, [x] aria-labels present, [ ] keyboard nav patterns documented.

jess-ux: I'll update the comp with changes: explicit SSO policy column, revised copy, confirmation modal copy, and the audit deep-link idea. I'll also add a keyboard nav appendix. Will ping when ready for final pass. :thumbsup:

maria-product: Thanks — will prepare acceptance criteria for PM and Security review. Suggestion: ship compact mode behind a feature flag for early rollout.

samir-eng: Feature flag makes rollout + rollback easier. I'll add a telemetry event for compact_mode_toggle and per-role sso_change.

olivia-security: Please include audit events for who made the change and the prior value. That's required for compliance.

jess-ux: Noted. Final question: anyone strongly prefer inline SSO toggle over modal override? If not, we'll go with modal override to be safer.

maria-product: Modal override: +1 from product.

samir-eng: Modal override: +0 from infra (neutral but implementation ok).

olivia-security: Modal override: +1 from security.

jess-ux: Great — modal override it is. I'll upload updated frames and ping again. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
